description.en: A halftone-dot room on a rainy day: rain on the window, a spinning record, string lights, and a mascot typing at a desk.
description.zh: 雨天的半色调圆点房间:窗外下雨,唱片转动,灯串闪烁,桌前有只吉祥物在打字。

usage.en: It applies at session start in the Code tab, with light and dark variants. Run /rainy-window off to take it off and /rainy-window on to put it back.
usage.zh: 在 Code 标签页的会话开始时自动应用,有浅色和深色两个版本。运行 /rainy-window off 取消,/rainy-window on 恢复。
